markdown_content: ## Overview of AI Avatar Studio in Clo 2025.0 This section introduces the AI Avatar Studio feature within Clo 2025.0, focusing on its render window integration and new background generation capabilities. It highlights the interface elements, workflow recommendations, and key functionalities such as face and background editing using prompts and images. --- ## Accessing and Using AI Studio for Avatar Face Generation AI Avatar Studio is accessed via the render window’s magic wand icon, which opens the AI studio interface. The studio is currently in beta, with ongoing improvements expected. - **Face Tab:** Users start in the Face tab to generate or refine avatar faces. - Input options include text prompts or direct image uploads. - Ideal input images are front-facing photos with clean lighting and no obstructions. - After uploading or generating a face, users can refine specific areas: - **Hair refinement** enhances hair details. - **Hands refinement** improves hand appearance. - **Garment refinement** polishes clothing textures and details. - These refinements improve realism and visual quality of the avatar. - **Workflow Tip:** Render your base avatar image first, then open it in AI Studio to maximize quality and consistency. Confirm that the face and garment are satisfactory before proceeding to background generation. --- ## Background Generation in AI Avatar Studio The Background tab is a new feature allowing users to generate or upload custom backgrounds for avatars. - **Background Input Options:** - Text prompts: Users can describe the desired background using keywords and natural language. - Image upload: Users may upload a rendered background image or any suitable picture. - **Prompt Features:** - Keyword suggestions help tailor the background style (e.g., "startup studio," "mystical"). - A pin icon allows locking a prompt to produce consistent variations. - Random prompt generation can inspire new background ideas. - **Generating and Refining Backgrounds:** - Users type or select keywords and hit "Generate" to create backgrounds. - Multiple generations can be done to select the best fit. - Scale and horizon alignment can be challenging, especially with images containing complex depth. - Background images with less depth and simpler horizons yield better results. - **Saving and History:** - Generated backgrounds can be saved directly within the studio. - A history panel tracks past generated backgrounds for easy access and reuse. --- ## Best Practices and Recommendations - Start with a well-rendered avatar face and garment before moving to backgrounds to ensure optimal integration. - Use front-facing and clearly lit images for face generation to improve AI accuracy. - Select gender where applicable to better guide face generation prompts. - When uploading background images, prefer those with minimal depth and clear horizon lines for better AI adaptation. - Use the prompt pinning feature to maintain style consistency across multiple background generations. - Experiment with multiple generations and prompt variations to find the most visually appealing backgrounds. --- ## Summary of Features and Improvements in Clo 2025.0 AI Avatar Studio - Introduction of the Background tab for customizable avatar backgrounds. - Enhanced face generation workflow with options for fine-tuning hair, hands, and garments. - Support for both text prompts and image uploads in face and background generation. - New tools for managing prompt consistency and history tracking. - Improved realism and integration between avatar faces and backgrounds, enabling more professional and creative outputs. --- This structured knowledge base provides detailed, actionable information on AI Avatar Studio’s face and background generation features in Clo 2025.0, supporting users in creating high-quality avatars with customizable environments.
